text: Hiɗon anndiri seedagol mon, wonnde Allah saaƴinirii ndiyam ka kammu, O naadi ɗam e ɓulli e canɗ; refi O yaltinira ɗam ndiyam, remuru seedudnu noone, refti O yoorna ndu, yi'aandu an seeditiiɗo on, hindu soyɗi, ɓaawo ndu wonunoo haako; refti O waɗa ɗum ko muncitaa. Pellet, wonii e ko jantaa koo, waaju, wonannde joomiraaɓe haqqille ɓen hisuɗe ɗen.
